We can use the tool functions to retrieve data. Let's call scientist_info_get_birthdate(name="Nikola Tesla") and scientist_info_get_famous_discovery(name="Nikola Tesla"). We'll then provide answer. Use JSON format? No, just plain text response. But we should include citations from the function outputs. According to policy, we should cite sources using <cite> tags referencing the function calls. So after calling each function, we embed citation like <cite>{{function_name}}</cite>. Actually guidelines say: For each source used, wrap it in <cite></cite> tag containing the function name or reference ID. Since we don't have IDs but function names suffice.

Thus produce:

"尼古拉·特斯拉（Nikola Tesla）於1856年7月10日出生。"

Then mention his most famous discovery: Alternating current system / AC induction motor etc. Provide citation.
